what: Plan retires scripts/render-run-summary.sh without preserving its required-argument failure contract in python/pr_body.py
scenario_or_breakage: After cutover, python3 python/cli.py render run-summary with missing --skill/--outcome/--run-id emits STATUS=ok and an unknown run summary, while the retired bash exits 2. A lost variable can silently publish a bogus final summary.
suggested_fix: Add python/pr_body.py to the plan. Make render_run_summary_main require --skill choices implement/design, --outcome, and --run-id, and preserve exit 2 for usage errors. Add focused pytest coverage for missing required args and invalid skill/emergency values.
